mapper.sql: select id, category_id, title, price, original_price, condition_level, description, images, stock, seller_id, seller_name, status, version, create_time, update_time from campus_product
mapper.insert: insert into campus_product (category_id, title, price, original_price, condition_level, description, images, stock, seller_id, seller_name, status, version) values (#{categoryId}, #{title}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{conditionLevel}, #{description}, #{images}, #{stock}, #{sellerId}, #{sellerName}, #{status}, 0)
mapper.update: update campus_product set stock = stock - #{count}, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and stock >= #{count}
update campus_product set stock = stock + #{count}, version = version + 1 where id = #{id}
